fields.name: Timeline
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D66C30 (ecl::TimelineSystem) creates a camera entity, adds the component (bg3.exe+0x1D7A020: zero Guid) and copies the 16-byte timeline Guid it was called with (also formatted as a GUID string to look the camera up). Consumer bg3.exe+0x1F1D8A0 (ecl::TimelineCameraSystem) formats the same 16 bytes as a GUID string for the camera name. Probe: 16 different random 16-byte values.

fields.name: Level
fields.evidence: Constructor writes -1; bg3.exe+0x1D66C30 assigns with IncRef/DecRef the current level name (ecl::LevelManager +0x90 -> +0x18 -> +8) or, when that is empty and the timeline flag +0x48C is set, a FixedString from ecl::EoCClient +0x140. bg3.exe+0x1F1D8A0 uses it to find the level (hash lookup) and stores it in the camera's level component. Probe: one constant FixedString 0x24F000A0.

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: Writer sets 1.0, or copies ls::EditorCameraBehavior +0x10 of the previous camera when one exists; bg3.exe+0x1F1D8A0 writes it to +0x10 of the new camera's ls::EditorCameraBehavior. Probe: always 1.0.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Writer sets 3, or copies ls::EditorCameraBehavior +0x3C; consumer writes it to +0x3C of the new ls::EditorCameraBehavior. Probe: always 3.

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: Writer sets 0; bg3.exe+0x1F1D8A0 copies the byte into byte 0 of the new camera's ecl::SceneCameraBehavior. Probe: 0.

open_questions: field_14 / field_18 mirror ls::EditorCameraBehavior +0x10 / +0x3C, field_1C mirrors ecl::SceneCameraBehavior +0; Script Extender has no layout for either, so they stay unnamed.
